title: Streaming Is Going to Cost More. That’s the Price of Mergers.
title_zh: 流媒体的成本将会更高。这就是合并的代价。
summary: ‘While consolidation has a tendency to increase pricing, it decreases churn,’ said Alex Holtz, research director of IDC.
summary_zh: IDC 研究总监 Alex Holtz 表示，虽然整合有提高定价的趋势，但它会减少客户流失。

title: TSMC’s US$2t Milestone And Apple Deal Reshape Chip Investment Case
title_zh: 台积电2吨里程碑与苹果交易重塑芯片投资案例
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE:TSM) has reached a market capitalization of about US$2t, placing it among the most highly valued companies globally.
summary_zh: 台积电 (NYSE:TSM) 的市值已达到约 2 吨美元，跻身全球估值最高的公司之列。

title: The billion-dollar infrastructure deals powering the AI boom
title_zh: 数十亿美元的基础设施交易推动人工智能热潮
summary: Here's everything we know about the biggest AI infrastructure projects, including major spending from Meta, Oracle, Microsoft, Google, and OpenAI.
summary_zh: 以下是我们所了解的有关最大的人工智能基础设施项目的所有信息，包括 Meta、Oracle、微软、谷歌和 OpenAI 的主要支出。

title: Is Blackstone’s (BX) ESOP Stock Offering Quietly Reframing Its Private Credit And Power Ambitions?
title_zh: Blackstone (BX) 的 ESOP 股票发行是否正在悄然重塑其私人信贷和权力野心？
summary: In late February 2026, Blackstone filed a shelf registration for approximately US$1.47 billion of common stock, linked to an ESOP-related offering of 12,765,875 shares.
summary_zh: 2026 年 2 月下旬，Blackstone 提交了约 14.7 亿美元普通股的搁置登记，与 ESOP 相关的 12,765,875 股发行相关。

title: Paramount Issuing $47 Billion of Equity at Big Premium to Stock Price for Warner Bros. Deal
title_zh: 派拉蒙以较股价大幅溢价收购华纳兄弟交易发行 470 亿美元股票
summary: Paramount Skydance  received a big vote of confidence from its controlling shareholders, including the Ellison family, when they agreed to fully back an equity offering to help fund the company’s deal for  Warner Bros. Discovery  at a big premium above Paramount’s stock price.
summary_zh: 派拉蒙 Skydance 获得了包括埃里森家族在内的控股股东的大力信任票，他们同意全额支持股票发行，以帮助该公司以高于派拉蒙股价的溢价收购华纳兄弟探索公司的交易提供资金。
